_doc: Task 6L section 8/18. Scene-disjoint split audit: tile overlap, source-feature identity leakage, RGB duplicate hashes and the documented boundary exclusions.
exclusion_reason: a feature crossing the ~1 m overlap between adjacent whole rasters would otherwise appear in two splits; these features are excluded from the scene-disjoint view only
interpretation: scene/raster separation only - not unseen-city or broad geographic generalization; no cross-city claim may be made from this split

rgb_duplicate_hashes.hash_definition: SHA256 of the 64x64 bilinear grayscale downsample of the tile image
rgb_duplicate_hashes.note: cross-split duplicates are only acceptable when the content is degenerate (near-uniform tiles); any non-degenerate cross-split duplicate is a leakage finding
